cases.name: Erin Nichole Johnson
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "After graduating college with a bachelor’s degree in history, she explored different careers before finding her passion of jewelry making, where she made beautiful necklaces and jewelry that sold on Etsy. By doing this, she was able to spend time with her son Owen while still making a living. Erin’s jewelry business was a complete hit and was very successful. She was an amazing, kind, caring, funny, intelligent mother, daughter, and best friend. She enjoyed traveling, camping, her jewelry, and spending time with her son.

Erin was a free-spirited soul, with remarkable creative and musical talents, a proud and protective mother, who was fearless in all her endeavors. Closest family members were so proud of the women she had become."
cases.narrative: On 1/6/2023, her body was found, along with her son's body, during a welfare check.
